notes.title: Update Note for March 11
notes.notes: Added RESTART button in pause menu!

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 12
notes.notes:
Stranger phase 2 had been unnecessarily annoying, so I made some adjustment:
[list]
[*] Stranger teleports less frequently 
[*] Reduced the hitbox of the side waves of Stranger's down-strike attack. It can be dodged by jumping.
[/list]
Now player should have more time window to attack the boss.
